machine: Radial medium-pressure fan VR 280-46 No.5 (ВР 280-46 №5), execution 1: housing on a frame, impeller on the motor shaft. Right rotation, housing position Pr 0 deg (outlet up).

size.note: Size No.5 chosen by the task brief.

execution.note: Frame mounted, direct drive on the motor shaft.

wheel_d.src: pasport p.3 sec.1.2.1: the number is given per GOST 10616-90
wheel_d.note: The impeller diameter is not printed in the pasport. GOST 10616-90 numbers fans by the impeller diameter in dm, so No.5 is 500 mm. Same reading as the brief (~500).

A.note: Outlet neck width; the housing axial width is taken equal to it (EST, no separate number).

axial_width.note: EST: the pasport gives no housing width along the shaft. Set equal to the neck A.

B.note: Overall width across the axis for Pr 0 deg, outlet flange included.

b.note: Housing reach on the side opposite to the outlet at Pr 0 deg (the right side of the sketch).

H.note: Outlet flange plane above the shaft axis at Pr 0 deg.

r90.note: Spiral radius 90 deg from the tongue (right side).

r180.src: pasport p.5 table Pr 90, b (the same radius seen after the 90 deg turn)
r180.note: Spiral radius 180 deg from the tongue (bottom). Pr 90 b=440 and Pr 270 b=440 agree.

r270.src: pasport p.5: (B - b) = 529 at Pr 0 minus (A1 - A)/2 = 29
r270.note: Spiral radius where it enters the neck (left side). 529 is the outlet flange edge, the neck wall is 29 mm inside it. The steps 379 -> 440 -> 500 are 61 and 60 mm per 90 deg, i.e. close to an Archimedean spiral (the fit in components._fit_spiral gives r = 315 + 0.683*theta(deg) mm for the extents); this is the only reading under which the three numbers are almost linear.

positions.src: pasport p.5, tables of housing positions, row VR 280-46-5
positions.note: Only these six positions exist for right rotation, execution 1. 180 and 225 deg (outlet down) are not offered.

sheet_t.note: NOT_FOUND. Housing sheet thickness EST 3 mm.

D.src: pasport p.4 table 1 (D), fig.1 view A
D.note: Inlet pipe outer diameter, read as the circle with the flange holes.

D1.src: pasport p.4 table 1 (D1), fig.1 view A

l.note: Inlet flange face from the base plane (the mid plane of the housing).

bolt_circle.note: EST: the middle between D and D1; the pasport gives no pitch circle.

throat_d.note: NOT_FOUND. Nozzle bore EST 0.92 of the impeller; the housing hole is 460 mm.

A1.note: Outlet flange width in the plane of the wheel.

A2.note: Outlet flange width along the shaft.

a1.note: Hole pitch across the plane of the wheel.

h.note: Shaft axis above the frame base.

C.src: pasport p.4 table 1 (C), fig.1 hole scheme
C.note: Mounting hole rectangle from the base plane to its far edge (motor side).

C1.note: Mounting hole rectangle width across the shaft.

C2.note: Mounting hole rectangle length along the shaft.

rail.note: NOT_FOUND. Rail channel h, b, tw, tf in mm, EST (UPN 100 class).

post.note: NOT_FOUND. Post and cradle SHS size, EST.

plate_t.note: NOT_FOUND. Motor base plate thickness, EST.

length.note: Inlet flange face to the motor fan-cover tip. The tabulated 4-pole motor in iec_motor is shorter than the 6-pole AIR132M6, so the motor is placed to keep this length.

kw.src: pasport p.7 table 3 and catalogue p.7, row No.5, 960 rpm
kw.note: Installed power. Passed to iec_motor(kw); the frame is picked there by kW, not by the pasport string.

rpm.note: The brief says 3000 rpm; the pasport and the catalogue list no 3000 rpm for No.5 (960 and 1450 only). 960 rpm with 7.5 kW is the row that matches the brief's 7.5 kW.

type.note: Information only. iec_motor tabulates 4-pole frames, so the drawn motor is its 7.5 kW frame.

blades.note: NOT_FOUND. The pasport does not give the blade count; backward-curved blades in the family name 'ВР 280-46' are an analog reading. EST 12.

width.note: NOT_FOUND. Blade width along the shaft, EST.

outer_d.note: NOT_FOUND. Tube between the housing back wall and the motor flange, EST.
